assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone production sprite for a 2D slightly overhead paper-craft campus board game.
Primary request: A small campus library corner building: cream paper walls, broad sky-blue folded gable roof, an elegant stack of three small coral/cream/blue books on the roof, tiny teal windows, centered wooden front double door, little cream entrance step. No attached path, no trees, no sign text.
Reference images are STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, never a target to copy wholesale. Match their hand-crafted folded paper, layered cut cardboard, warm cream, sky-blue, coral and muted teal palette. Real tangible miniature photographed with diffuse soft studio illumination and beautifully subtle paper fibers, clean edges. Camera: elevated near-orthographic 55 degrees looking down; front facade still visible; no dramatic isometric skew. The asset must be isolated, fully in frame with generous transparent margin around every edge, centered, with NO environment, NO rectangular backdrop, NO composited reference scene, NO large cast shadow outside the object. Truly transparent RGBA background. Very polished, clear at small game sprite size. Output one single object only, square 1024 px.
